//: Optional: wire secret-hygiene as a Claude Code PreToolUse hook so Claude's own git commits are scanned even in repos without the git pre-commit hook installed. Add this under "hooks" in ~/.claude/settings.json (or a project .claude/settings.json). The matcher fires on Bash; the command runs only when the bash command is a git commit, scans staged changes via the same pre-commit script, and a failed scan exits 2, which is the exit code that makes Claude Code block the tool call (exit 1 is only a warning). Adjust the path to where you cloned this repo.

hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) bash /path/to/claude-skills/hooks/secret-hygiene/pre-commit 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
